generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Contractors should have registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc.
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 50% of cost of works i.e. Rs. 13.82 Lakhs

The successful bidder would be required to give performance bank guarantee of 5% of the contract amount plus additional security for unbalanced bid amount from a Nationalized / Scheduled Indian Bank, with jurisdiction at Bangalore as specified, towards guarantee for completion of work within the stipulated period.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in kppp portal

The tenderer Should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of rupees not less than, 27.63 Lakhs (profit and loss account, Balance sheet certified, Audited by Chartered Accountant are mandatory)
